productForm.addDescription: Fill in the steps below. Only the name and how you sell it are required.
productForm.skuHint: Leave blank to generate one. Stored in capitals.
productForm.unitsHint: Stock is always counted in the base unit, the smallest unit you ever sell (piece, gram, ml). Every other unit says how many of an earlier unit it holds. Each unit has its own prices, so a packet does not have to cost 35 × the piece price.
productForm.baseLocked: This product already has stock or history, so its base unit stays the same. Renaming it does not convert stock.
productForm.pricesReadOnly: Your role cannot change prices; price fields are read-only.
productForm.barcodesHint: Scan a manufacturer barcode into the field, or generate an in-store code. A barcode linked to a package unit (e.g. Carton) selects that unit when scanned at the POS.
productForm.imageHint: Resized to a small thumbnail and saved with the product.
productForm.allowFractionHint: e.g. 1.5 KG. Quantities are still stored as whole {unit}.
productForm.trackBatchesHint: Record a batch number on each purchase.
productForm.trackExpiryHint: Sells the earliest-expiring batch first and blocks expired stock.
productForm.name: Name

step.sellingHint: Pick the option that fits. Stock is counted correctly for every unit automatically.
step.pricesHint: Enter the selling price for each unit. Wholesale and cost price are optional.

kinds.label: How the product is sold
kinds.optional: Optional. Leave empty if you never sell it this way.

piece.title: By piece
piece.hint: Sold and counted one by one.

pack.title: Piece and packet
pack.bigHint: Also sold in a bigger box? (optional, e.g. a carton of packets)

weight.title: By weight
weight.hint: Sold in KG, in any amount: 0.5 KG, 1.25 KG and so on. Stock is kept exactly in grams.
weight.sackSize: Also sold by the sack? KG in 1 sack

liquid.title: Liquid
liquid.hint: Sold in liters, in any amount: 0.5 L, 2 L and so on. Stock is kept exactly in ML.

custom.title: Custom
custom.hint: For unusual products: define the units and their prices yourself below.

productForm.moreOptionsHint: SKU, tax, description, batch and expiry tracking.
